units: integer nanoseconds for timestamps/costs; branchcounts integers; utilization fractions of oneCPU; ratios dimensionless

exclusive_host_buckets.guest_run_ns: ordinary KVM_RUN windows, excluding all correction windows; includes unknown kernel entry/exit overhead, so this is a raw measurement, not exact pure guestCPU
exclusive_host_buckets.natural_exit_handling_ns: userspace handling/completion/entry preparation for naturalexits outside KVM_RUN and outside precise-stop intervals; world/device work timed separately
exclusive_host_buckets.precise_stop_ns: overflow detection through validatedexact landing, including correction KVM_RUN windows and debugadministration; nested natural-exit guestwork remains here in raw accounting and is separately counted bykind
exclusive_host_buckets.world_device_ns: world events/fabric/block/device/controller work outside theother buckets
exclusive_host_buckets.witness_ns: hash/capture/serialization for selected witnessmode outside otherbuckets
exclusive_host_buckets.other_ns: all remaining ownerthread work includingmeasurement/logging overhead; no unexplained hidden time

accounting: singleownerthread monotonic timers: nonoverlapping exhaustivesegments; record bucket,role,start/end,semantic boundaryid; bucket sum equals end-to-endhostwall within stated<=1% timeruncertainty, otherwise report invalid
derived_split: optional estimatedpure_guestCPU and kernel natural-entryexit cost from separately measured matched primitives; replace costs inside guest_run, never add estimates to rawtotal. precise_stop keeps its own guestcorrection time; report cost percorrected branch/instruction and anyguestCPU estimate inside stop separately.
natural_exit_metric: calibrated roundtrip primitive including KVMexit/reentry and matching completion; userspace handlerduration alone is not <=10us naturalexit acceptance
precise_stop_metric: wallcost from requested interruption/overflow through exactvalidated stop, including configuredmargin guestwork and correction. Report p50/p95/max, correctionsteps, overshoot failures and count ofnatural exits during correction.
wakeup_metric: mechanismoverhead across attributed exclusive segments of actual halted->runnable episode; guestbusinessCPU and allocation uncertainty separately reported; no wakeup claim from nativecontextswitchproxy
device_timing: retain integration-contract.json device timing records: exact scheduled arrival and world-effect processing separately from IRQ readiness, injection, acceptance and handler entry. IF/shadow deferral is guest semantics; progress past an unprocessed due world effect invalidates scheduling. Unobserved guest stages remain null with declared capture coverage.
speed: report60s active-host ratio, measured(end-to-endsimduration)/(fullhostduration), and fixed60s/fullhostduration; >=10x target uses fixed60s/fullhost to prevent recovery-drain numerator inflation
model: hostseconds/simsecond = sumrole(utilization*busy_slowdown) + sumrole(wakeup_rate*wakeup_mechanism_cost_s) + accounted nonoverlapping stop/world/witness residuals; measure overlaps and do not add costs already included in slowdown/wakeup terms
witness_modes: normal and check each produce their ownhost totals/distributions; identical profile/snapshot/calibration required to compare
unmeasured: null values plus explicitqualification='unmeasured'; never zero-cost or targetpass defaults
deciding: actual benchmark result requires qualified host/calibration/snapshot/fault evidence plus5freshprocess matches and independentreview; exploratorylocal cases report scope once
